events.description: Kill giant rats until 6 animal bones are in the bag.
events.explanation: The item is named 'Animal Bone'. The wiki's giant rat drop list shows only Raw Rat Meat, Coarse Animal Fur, Animal Hide Scraps and Small Animal Fang. It doesn't list animal bones, so bones may not drop from rats at all. I'll kill rats in a loop and check the bag. If 10 kills give no bones, the step aborts and we ask Zezima. The bag is empty, so the only gear is the Bronze Sword. Rats are power 2 and weak to stab, and a sword stabs.

Kill the nearest giant rat and check for bones
